title: Not so easy
text: Not so easy. This was just not so easy to do. It takes a really long time to make a little ice cream. It can be frustrating and involves gong back and forth. Directions were not great.  love the idea and so do the kids, but I think there are other products that can do the same thing in a better way.

product_metadata.title: Little Kids Magic Kidchen Make Your Own Ice Cream with Real Food Ingredients Kid Friendly Cooking Activity Ice Cream Tray Toy, Purple
features: Magic Kidchen Ice Cream Tray let’s your child create real ice cream in minutes using real food ingredients that you have at home!
Includes special ice cream tray with patented rapid freeze technology, toppings station, and ice cream making utensils.

To use just follow the instructions to fill the tray with a salt water mixture, place the tray in the freezer upside down and leave in the freezer for 4-6 hours or overnight, then take out of the freezer and your child is ready to make ice cream in minutes

Magic Kidchen Ice Cream tray works with real food! Your child can choose between their favorite dairy, cream, or dairy alternative flavors to make the ice cream and then choose their favorite toppings to mix into their ice cream. Real food is not included
Magic Kidchen items are BPA Free, non-toxic, reusable and top rack dishwasher safe. For Ages 4 years+
description: "Kids can create tasty frozen treats in minutes with Magic Kidchen! Magic Kidchen lets kids create their own frozen treats with limited help from adults! With our patented freeze technology your child uses real food to create frozen treats in minutes. It is so easy to use that it seems like magic. The Magic Kidchen Ice Cream Tray comes with our special patented rapid freeze technology tray, toppings station, and utensils. To use you just follow the instructions to fill the tray with a salt water mixture, place the tray in the freezer upside down and let the tray freeze for 4-6 hours or overnight. When it is ready to use, your child places the tray into the activity station, and pours a thin layer of milk, cream, or dairy alternative on the tray. Take your spatula and push the flavor of choice back and forth until just like magic your child instantly sees their ice cream begin to form. Once your ice cream is formed, your child moves over to the toppings station and mixes in their favorite ice cream additions. All Magic Kidchen items are BPA Free, non-toxic, reusable, and top rack dishwasher safe. Real food not included but can easily be found in your household or local store. Ages 4 years+ "
